units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 6|name|407|0
units.english: Flee back to Successor space
units.italian: Fuggi verso lo spazio dei Successori

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 6|description|408|0
units.english: Escape the warships attacking you and regroup in Successor space.
units.italian: Sfuggi alle navi da guerra che ti attaccano e radunati nello spazio dei Successori.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 6|dialog|421|0
units.english: As the second drone ship explodes it transmits some data to your vessel. It cannot be deciphered at this time.
units.italian: Quando la seconda nave drone esplode, trasmette alcuni dati alla tua nave. Al momento non è possibile decifrarli.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 6|dialog|425|0
units.english: Ijaset instructs you to land on the uninhabited world here to hand over the Predecessor artifacts.
units.italian: Ijaset ti ordina di atterrare sul mondo disabitato qui vicino per consegnare i manufatti dei Predecessori.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 6|log|428|0
units.english: Handed off the jewelry House Myurej wanted after being chased out of Predecessor space by a pair of long-ranged warships.
units.italian: Hai consegnato i gioielli che Casa Myurej voleva, dopo essere stato cacciato dallo spazio dei Predecessori da due navi da guerra a lungo raggio.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 6|The <ship> comes to rest on the gentle hills of <planet> next to an unassuming-looking Myaede freighter. Though the air here is too rarefied for you to breathe, Ijaset and the two Successor soldiers seem to handle it well enough, transferring their haul of little boxes over to the freighter. As you watch from your ship, you think you recognize the captain of the freighter as the same merchant captain you spoke to back on Kasii-Tuur-Saqru. The two soldiers board the freighter, while Ijaset returns to your ship to speak with you.|430|0
units.english: The <ship> comes to rest on the gentle hills of <planet> next to an unassuming-looking Myaede freighter. Though the air here is too rarefied for you to breathe, Ijaset and the two Successor soldiers seem to handle it well enough, transferring their haul of little boxes over to the freighter. As you watch from your ship, you think you recognize the captain of the freighter as the same merchant captain you spoke to back on Kasii-Tuur-Saqru. The two soldiers board the freighter, while Ijaset returns to your ship to speak with you.
units.italian: La <ship> si posa sulle colline morbide di <planet>, accanto a un cargo Myaede dall'aspetto dimesso. L'aria qui è troppo rarefatta perché tu possa respirarla, ma Ijaset e i due soldati Successori sembrano reggerla senza problemi, e trasferiscono il loro carico di scatolette sul cargo. Mentre guardi dalla tua nave, ti pare di riconoscere il capitano del cargo: è lo stesso capitano mercante con cui hai parlato su Kasii-Tuur-Saqru. I due soldati salgono sul cargo, mentre Ijaset torna sulla tua nave per parlarti.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 6|	"Well done, <last>," they say. "Thou kept thy calm very well."|431|0
units.english: "Well done, <last>," they say. "Thou kept thy calm very well."
units.italian: "Ben fatto, <last>," dicono. "Hai mantenuto la calma molto bene."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 6|	"Do you know anything about those ships that attacked us?"|433|0
units.english: "Do you know anything about those ships that attacked us?"
units.italian: "Sai qualcosa delle navi che ci hanno attaccato?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 6|	"Why the secrecy?"|434|0
units.english: "Why the secrecy?"
units.italian: "Perché tutta questa segretezza?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 6|	Ijaset lets out a long sigh, accompanied by muted color. "Ancient warships, it would seem, built by our Predecessors in their day. There's aught familiar about them, but they were not Myurej's, if that concerns thee. Something..." Crimson sparkles dot their skin, reminiscent of anger or frustration, "T'weren't some grand heirlooms like the Houses smuggled 'cross the wormhole, at least. I suspect they were waiting for us, or some like us, to disturb the lost worlds' esoterica."|438|0
units.english: Ijaset lets out a long sigh, accompanied by muted color. "Ancient warships, it would seem, built by our Predecessors in their day. There's aught familiar about them, but they were not Myurej's, if that concerns thee. Something..." Crimson sparkles dot their skin, reminiscent of anger or frustration, "T'weren't some grand heirlooms like the Houses smuggled 'cross the wormhole, at least. I suspect they were waiting for us, or some like us, to disturb the lost worlds' esoterica."
units.italian: Ijaset emette un lungo sospiro, accompagnato da un colore spento. "Navi da guerra antiche, a quanto pare, costruite dai nostri Predecessori ai loro tempi. C'è qualcosa di familiare, ma non erano di Myurej, se è questo che ti preoccupa. Qualcosa..." Scintille cremisi punteggiano la loro pelle, come collera o frustrazione, "almeno non erano grandi cimeli di famiglia come quelli che le Casate hanno contrabbandato attraverso il wormhole. Sospetto che aspettassero noi, o qualcuno come noi, per disturbare l'esoterica dei mondi perduti."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 6|	"Why all the secrecy?"|440|0
units.english: "Why all the secrecy?"
units.italian: "Perché tutto questo mistero?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 6|	Ijaset leans against a bulkhead. "I think Myurej wishes to place our trinkets in the arms of someone who knows not what they are. They do not trust thee, and canst thou blame them?"|443|0
units.english: Ijaset leans against a bulkhead. "I think Myurej wishes to place our trinkets in the arms of someone who knows not what they are. They do not trust thee, and canst thou blame them?"
units.italian: Ijaset si appoggia a una paratia. "Penso che Myurej voglia mettere i nostri ninnoli nelle mani di qualcuno che non sa cosa sono. Non si fidano di te, e puoi biasimarli?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 6|	"I suppose not."|445|0
units.english: "I suppose not."
units.italian: "Suppongo di no."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 6|	"Yes I can, actually."|446|0
units.english: "Yes I can, actually."
units.italian: "In realtà sì, posso."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 6|	"'Tis fair, <last>," they say. "I should inform thee that thy agreed-upon fee of <payment> should be released to thee soon. As for Myurej's favor, 'tisn't aught I can convey to thee myself. I suspect they'll wish to contact thee on their own time to decide upon thy status with the House. Until then, I'll take my leave of thee. If we meet again, may it be on pleasant terms."|447|0
units.english: "'Tis fair, <last>," they say. "I should inform thee that thy agreed-upon fee of <payment> should be released to thee soon. As for Myurej's favor, 'tisn't aught I can convey to thee myself. I suspect they'll wish to contact thee on their own time to decide upon thy status with the House. Until then, I'll take my leave of thee. If we meet again, may it be on pleasant terms."
units.italian: "È giusto, <last>," dicono. "Ti informo che la tua tariffa concordata di <payment> ti sarà versata presto. Quanto al favore di Myurej, non è cosa che possa trasmetterti io. Suppongo che vorranno contattarti quando vorranno, per decidere della tua posizione con la Casa. Fino ad allora, ti lascio. Se ci incontreremo di nuovo, che sia in termini piacevoli."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 7|name|451|0
units.english: Return to Myurej
units.italian: Torna da Myurej

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 7|description|452|0
units.english: Return to House Myurej at <destination> to find out if they have anything more for you.
units.italian: Torna da Casa Myurej su <destination> per scoprire se hanno ancora qualcosa per te.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 7|Shortly after you land at the spaceport here, you receive a message delivered via data-sphere:|462|0
units.english: Shortly after you land at the spaceport here, you receive a message delivered via data-sphere:
units.italian: Poco dopo essere atterrato allo spazioporto, ricevi un messaggio consegnato tramite una sfera di dati:

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 7|	Captain <first> <last>. House Myurej asks that thou join us on <planet> as soon as thou mayst, so that we may conclude our business with thee.|463|0
units.english: Captain <first> <last>. House Myurej asks that thou join us on <planet> as soon as thou mayst, so that we may conclude our business with thee.
units.italian: Capitano <first> <last>. Casa Myurej ti chiede di unirti a noi su <planet> appena ti è possibile, così da concludere i nostri affari con te.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 7|	As soon as it finishes playing, it adds a waypoint to your ship's map.|464|0
units.english: As soon as it finishes playing, it adds a waypoint to your ship's map.
units.italian: Appena la riproduzione finisce, aggiunge un punto di rotta alla mappa della tua nave.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|name|469|0
units.english: Deliver wedding supplies
units.italian: Consegna le forniture per il matrimonio

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|description|470|0
units.english: A dockworker at <origin> has directed you to deliver <tons> of wedding supplies for House Myurej to <destination>.
units.italian: Un addetto portuale di <origin> ti ha incaricato di consegnare <tons> di forniture per il matrimonio di Casa Myurej su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|Once again traffic control directs you to the reserved portion of the <origin> spaceport with the bronze-trimmed landing pads. You are met outside by a somewhat stressed-looking dockworker who brightens up considerably when they see you.|478|0
units.english: Once again traffic control directs you to the reserved portion of the <origin> spaceport with the bronze-trimmed landing pads. You are met outside by a somewhat stressed-looking dockworker who brightens up considerably when they see you.
units.italian: Ancora una volta il controllo del traffico ti indirizza alla parte riservata dello spazioporto di <origin>, con le piazzole dai bordi di bronzo. Fuori ti accoglie un addetto portuale dall'aria piuttosto stressata, che si illumina parecchio quando ti vede.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	"Of course, of course," they say, "we've been waiting for thee! A House transport to <planet> of supplies for the wedding, yes?"|479|0
units.english: "Of course, of course," they say, "we've been waiting for thee! A House transport to <planet> of supplies for the wedding, yes?"
units.italian: "Certo, certo," dice, "ti stavamo aspettando! Un trasporto della Casa verso <planet>, con le forniture per il matrimonio, giusto?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	"Excuse me?"|481|0
units.english: "Excuse me?"
units.italian: "Come scusa?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	"I was suppose to meet someone here, I think."|482|0
units.english: "I was suppose to meet someone here, I think."
units.italian: "Credo di dover incontrare qualcuno qui."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	The worker checks their datapad, looking back and forth between it and you before they once again announce with confidence that you are supposed to transport <tons> of wedding supplies to <planet> for the upcoming Myurej wedding.|483|0
units.english: The worker checks their datapad, looking back and forth between it and you before they once again announce with confidence that you are supposed to transport <tons> of wedding supplies to <planet> for the upcoming Myurej wedding.
units.italian: L'addetto controlla il datapad, guardando alternatamente lui e te, prima di annunciare di nuovo con sicurezza che devi trasportare <tons> di forniture per il matrimonio imminente di Myurej su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	"Well, get them loaded, I suppose."|485|0
units.english: "Well, get them loaded, I suppose."
units.italian: "Beh, suppongo che dovrai caricale."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	"I'll come back later."|487|0
units.english: "I'll come back later."
units.italian: "Tornerò più tardi."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|log|492|0
units.english: Spoke with Khiajsore, a scion of House Myurej, at an underwater venue where an inter-House wedding is set to occur.
units.italian: Hai parlato con Khiajsore, erede di Casa Myurej, in una sede subacquea dove sta per svolgersi un matrimonio tra Casate.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|The <ship> settles down in one of the metal bubbles of the <planet> spaceport and before long, as the ground crew is unloading your ship's cargo, a pair of House Myurej's soldiers comes to lead you through the facility. They take you to an elevator outside of the spaceport's public area; you step in, and a few seconds after it begins moving, it clears the bulk of the spaceport complex and shows you a fantastic view of the planet's ocean as it descends deeper into the water. Unfortunately you're on the wrong side of the planet to see the bioluminscent algal streams of the "Ribbons of Iret," but even the relatively dark sea is impressive in its scale and in the vastness of the underwater infrastructure the Successors have built within it.|494|0
units.english: The <ship> settles down in one of the metal bubbles of the <planet> spaceport and before long, as the ground crew is unloading your ship's cargo, a pair of House Myurej's soldiers comes to lead you through the facility. They take you to an elevator outside of the spaceport's public area; you step in, and a few seconds after it begins moving, it clears the bulk of the spaceport complex and shows you a fantastic view of the planet's ocean as it descends deeper into the water. Unfortunately you're on the wrong side of the planet to see the bioluminscent algal streams of the "Ribbons of Iret," but even the relatively dark sea is impressive in its scale and in the vastness of the underwater infrastructure the Successors have built within it.
units.italian: La <ship> si posa in una delle bolle metalliche dello spazioporto di <planet> e, poco dopo, mentre la squadra di terra scarica il carico, due soldati di Casa Myurej vengono a guidarti attraverso la struttura. Ti portano a un ascensore fuori dall'area pubblica dello spazioporto; entri, e pochi secondi dopo la partenza l'ascensore supera il grosso del complesso e ti mostra una vista fantastica sull'oceano del pianeta mentre scende più in profondità nell'acqua. Purtroppo sei dalla parte sbagliata del pianeta per vedere i rivoli algali bioluminescenti dei "Ribbons of Iret", ma anche il mare relativamente scuro è impressionante per la sua scala e per la vastità delle infrastrutture subacquee che i Successori vi hanno costruito.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	Eventually the elevator nestles into a complex on the seafloor, and the two guards guide you through a number of transparent halls to a large central area. Fish swim above you, schooling behind a circular oculus. Another Successor approaches from one of the side corridors, and it is immediately apparent that this is one of Myurej's scions - they are draped in enough red gold and jewels that it's a wonder they can hold their body upright. When they speak, it's not the voice you heard behind the waving screen before, but one that's smoother and more inquisitive.|495|0
units.english: Eventually the elevator nestles into a complex on the seafloor, and the two guards guide you through a number of transparent halls to a large central area. Fish swim above you, schooling behind a circular oculus. Another Successor approaches from one of the side corridors, and it is immediately apparent that this is one of Myurej's scions - they are draped in enough red gold and jewels that it's a wonder they can hold their body upright. When they speak, it's not the voice you heard behind the waving screen before, but one that's smoother and more inquisitive.
units.italian: Alla fine l'ascensore si adagia in un complesso sul fondo del mare, e le due guardie ti guidano attraverso una serie di corridoi trasparenti fino a una grande area centrale. Sopra di te nuotano i pesci, in banchi dietro un oculo circolare. Un altro Successore arriva da uno dei corridoi laterali, ed è subito evidente che si tratta di uno degli eredi di Myurej: sono coperti di tanto oro rosso e di tanti gioielli che è un miracolo che riescano a tenersi dritti. Quando parlano, non è la voce che hai sentito dietro lo schermo ondeggiante, ma una più morbida e più curiosa.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	"Captain, captain," they say, "thou, Captain, who hast brought us such lovely glitterings with such fine loyalty. And through such perilous straits, I hear as well? The knave Riiria, the fearsome guardians of the Shroud... I could not bear to keep myself from seeing thee in the flesh, the flesh that holds all this surpassing strength!" Their adornments rattle as they gesture, prodding the air gently.|496|0
units.english: "Captain, captain," they say, "thou, Captain, who hast brought us such lovely glitterings with such fine loyalty. And through such perilous straits, I hear as well? The knave Riiria, the fearsome guardians of the Shroud... I could not bear to keep myself from seeing thee in the flesh, the flesh that holds all this surpassing strength!" Their adornments rattle as they gesture, prodding the air gently.
units.italian: "Capitano, capitano," dicono, "tu, capitano, che ci hai portato così graziosi scintillii con così nobile lealtà. E attraverso stretti così pericolosi, mi dicono? Il farabutto Riiria, i temibili guardiani dello Shroud... non potevo sopportare di non vederti in carne e ossa, la carne che racchiude tutta questa forza superiore!" I loro ornamenti tintinnano mentre gesticolano, pungolando l'aria con delicatezza.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	"I hope I live up to your expectations."|498|0
units.english: "I hope I live up to your expectations."
units.italian: "Spero di essere all'altezza delle tue aspettative."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	"It seems like a lot of effort for some little trinkets."|500|0
units.english: "It seems like a lot of effort for some little trinkets."
units.italian: "Sembra un bel po' di fatica per dei piccoli ninnoli."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	"And you are?"|502|0
units.english: "And you are?"
units.italian: "E tu chi sei?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	The scion fans their arms gently. "Myurej M- Khiajsore. A cousin of the one who spoke to thee earlier, whom thou shalt recall."|503|0
units.english: The scion fans their arms gently. "Myurej M- Khiajsore. A cousin of the one who spoke to thee earlier, whom thou shalt recall."
units.italian: L'erede apre le braccia con delicatezza. "Myurej M- Khiajsore. Cugino di colui che ti ha parlato prima, che ricorderai."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	"Quite so!" the scion says. "They say a - what is it - a 'biped fever' runs through the people since thou arriv'st, that all at once all the worlds clamor for stories of artful, noble humans in the heyday of our Predecessors. I did not see the appeal at first, but by thy actions and seeing thee now... there's a certain strange elegance to the few arms, thine incomplete symmetry." They hum briefly. "But forgive me, that's not what we're here for, thou or I." They fan their arms in a fluid motion. "Myurej M- Khiajsore. I'm a cousin of the one who spoke to thee earlier, behind the veil."|506|0
units.english: "Quite so!" the scion says. "They say a - what is it - a 'biped fever' runs through the people since thou arriv'st, that all at once all the worlds clamor for stories of artful, noble humans in the heyday of our Predecessors. I did not see the appeal at first, but by thy actions and seeing thee now... there's a certain strange elegance to the few arms, thine incomplete symmetry." They hum briefly. "But forgive me, that's not what we're here for, thou or I." They fan their arms in a fluid motion. "Myurej M- Khiajsore. I'm a cousin of the one who spoke to thee earlier, behind the veil."
units.italian: "Proprio così!" dice l'erede. "Dicono che una... come si chiama... una 'febbre dei bipedi' si sia diffusa tra la gente da quando sei arrivato, che all'improvviso tutti i mondi invochino storie di umani nobili e ingegnosi nel pieno dei nostri Predecessori. All'inizio non ne capivo il fascino, ma dalle tue azioni e vedendoti ora... c'è una strana eleganza in quelle poche braccia, nella tua simmetria incompleta." Emettono un breve ronzio. "Ma perdonami, non è per questo che siamo qui, né tu né io." Aprono le braccia con un movimento fluido. "Myurej M- Khiajsore. Sono cugino di colui che ti ha parlato prima, dietro il velo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	The scion extends a gilded arm, shaking the myriad piercings and bits of jewelry upon it as if to contemplate them. "Oh, thou think'st me materialistic, mayhaps? Yet precious things are only made precious by the pain of acquiring them. The jewels thou didst bring back from the Shroud have already earned their own stories... as the beginning of a grand project of restoration, maybe, and at least as something totally unique." They hum with satisfaction. "And yet, 'tis not what we're here for, thou or I." They fan their arms in acknowledgment. "Myurej M- Khiajsore. A cousin of the one who spoke to thee earlier, behind the veil."|509|0
units.english: The scion extends a gilded arm, shaking the myriad piercings and bits of jewelry upon it as if to contemplate them. "Oh, thou think'st me materialistic, mayhaps? Yet precious things are only made precious by the pain of acquiring them. The jewels thou didst bring back from the Shroud have already earned their own stories... as the beginning of a grand project of restoration, maybe, and at least as something totally unique." They hum with satisfaction. "And yet, 'tis not what we're here for, thou or I." They fan their arms in acknowledgment. "Myurej M- Khiajsore. A cousin of the one who spoke to thee earlier, behind the veil."
units.italian: L'erede allunga un braccio dorato, facendo tintinnare i molti piercing e gioielli che lo ricoprono, come per contemplarli. "Oh, mi credi forse materialista? Eppure le cose preziose diventano preziose solo per il dolore di procurarsele. I gioielli che hai riportato dallo Shroud si sono già guadagnati le loro storie... come inizio di un grande progetto di restauro, forse, e almeno come qualcosa di del tutto unico." Emettono un ronzio soddisfatto. "E tuttavia non è per questo che siamo qui, né tu né io." Aprono le braccia in segno di riconoscimento. "Myurej M- Khiajsore. Sono cugino di colui che ti ha parlato prima, dietro il velo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	Khiajsore motions for you to join them on a stroll through the complex, the guards staying several meters behind. Plants with saffron-colored flowers line water-filled channels on the floor; their heads follow the two of you as you walk and slither along.|511|0
units.english: Khiajsore motions for you to join them on a stroll through the complex, the guards staying several meters behind. Plants with saffron-colored flowers line water-filled channels on the floor; their heads follow the two of you as you walk and slither along.
units.italian: Khiajsore ti fa cenno di unirti a loro per una passeggiata nel complesso, con le guardie che restano diversi metri indietro. Piante dai fiori color zafferano costeggiano canali pieni d'acqua sul pavimento; le loro corolle seguono voi due mentre camminate e strisciate avanti.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	"'Tis about our friends at House Kaatrij," they say.|514|0
units.english: "'Tis about our friends at House Kaatrij," they say.
units.italian: "Riguarda i nostri amici di Casa Kaatrij," dicono.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	"'Tis about our friends at House Kaatrij," they say. "Thou'rt a friend to them, too, I know. Mirth runs up me every time I see Riijaaora, knowing what thou deni'dst them. 'Twere always an ill-mooded sort."|517|0
units.english: "'Tis about our friends at House Kaatrij," they say. "Thou'rt a friend to them, too, I know. Mirth runs up me every time I see Riijaaora, knowing what thou deni'dst them. 'Twere always an ill-mooded sort."
units.italian: "Riguarda i nostri amici di Casa Kaatrij," dicono. "Sei amico anche loro, lo so. L'ilarità mi sale addosso ogni volta che vedo Riijaaora, sapendo ciò che gli hai negato. È sempre stato un tipo di cattivo umore."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	One of the saffron plants bursts into a cloud of pollen that forms a film on the surface of the channel's water. "I've known Kaatrij for long now, all their love for secrecy and understatement. I think, dear captain, that they are wounded and volatile, and I know," they say, sparkling with energy, "that someone else behind the scenes moves all their pieces round and round and is, for now, winning this grand game."|519|0
units.english: One of the saffron plants bursts into a cloud of pollen that forms a film on the surface of the channel's water. "I've known Kaatrij for long now, all their love for secrecy and understatement. I think, dear captain, that they are wounded and volatile, and I know," they say, sparkling with energy, "that someone else behind the scenes moves all their pieces round and round and is, for now, winning this grand game."
units.italian: Una delle piante color zafferano esplode in una nuvola di polline che forma una pellicola sulla superficie dell'acqua del canale. "Conosco Kaatrij da molto ormai, con tutto il loro amore per la segretezza e la sobrietà. Penso, caro capitano, che siano feriti e instabili, e so," dicono, scintillando di energia, "che qualcun altro, dietro le quinte, muove tutti i loro pezzi in tondo e per ora sta vincendo questa grande partita."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	"I'm not ready to jump to conclusions."|521|0
units.english: "I'm not ready to jump to conclusions."
units.italian: "Non sono pronto a saltare alle conclusioni."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	"Why not Myurej?"|522|0
units.english: "Why not Myurej?"
units.italian: "Perché non Myurej?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	Mirth speckles the scion's skin. "Dost thou seek to add wisdom to thy list of virtues? I speak of this to thee so that thou mightst appreciate the circumstances in which thou earn'st our favor, in which we shall deliver it. Soon enough, as we the Houses promise thee ships and technologies, there will be a new day of chaos, and we shall promise thee these things as our inhibitions wane and our judgment warps in the glare of this new light."|524|0
units.english: Mirth speckles the scion's skin. "Dost thou seek to add wisdom to thy list of virtues? I speak of this to thee so that thou mightst appreciate the circumstances in which thou earn'st our favor, in which we shall deliver it. Soon enough, as we the Houses promise thee ships and technologies, there will be a new day of chaos, and we shall promise thee these things as our inhibitions wane and our judgment warps in the glare of this new light."
units.italian: L'ilarità macchia la pelle dell'erede. "Cerchi di aggiungere la saggezza alla tua lista di virtù? Te ne parlo perché tu possa apprezzare le circostanze in cui ti guadagni il nostro favore, e in cui te lo consegneremo. Presto, mentre noi Casate ti promettiamo navi e tecnologie, arriverà un nuovo giorno di caos, e te le prometteremo mentre le nostre inibizioni si affievoliscono e il nostro giudizio si deforma nella luce di questo nuovo sole."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	Khiajsore hums again. It almost sounds like a piece of music; nothing you're familiar with, of course. "Myurej, Myurej, Myurej," they say. "For the rest here, Myurej is the state, but for those of us within it, Myurej is family. Were we the ones making up this crisis, I surely wouldn't tell thee, discreet as thou mayst have proven thyself." Jovial pastels color the scion's gilded body. "Soon enough, we the Houses shall promise thee all sorts of trinkets - ships and technologies - as our inhibitions fade in this ongoing disorder. Our judgment will be turned to new aims."|527|0
units.english: Khiajsore hums again. It almost sounds like a piece of music; nothing you're familiar with, of course. "Myurej, Myurej, Myurej," they say. "For the rest here, Myurej is the state, but for those of us within it, Myurej is family. Were we the ones making up this crisis, I surely wouldn't tell thee, discreet as thou mayst have proven thyself." Jovial pastels color the scion's gilded body. "Soon enough, we the Houses shall promise thee all sorts of trinkets - ships and technologies - as our inhibitions fade in this ongoing disorder. Our judgment will be turned to new aims."
units.italian: Khiajsore emette di nuovo quel ronzio. Sembra quasi un pezzo di musica; niente che tu conosca, naturalmente. "Myurej, Myurej, Myurej," dicono. "Per chi sta qui fuori, Myurej è lo Stato, ma per noi che ci siamo dentro, Myurej è la famiglia. Se fossimo noi a creare questa crisi, di certo non te lo direi, per discreto che tu abbia saputo essere." Tinte pastello gioviali colorano il corpo dorato dell'erede. "Presto noi Casate ti prometteremo ogni sorta di ninnoli, navi e tecnologie, mentre le nostre inibizioni svaniscono in questo disordine. Il nostro giudizio sarà volto a nuovi fini."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	Khiajsore stops in a circular room where the flowers have spread out to colonize the space, dusting the air and water alike with their bright pollen. "I wish to invite thee to our wedding, Captain. Not mine!" they chuckle, "but Myurej's. 'Twill take place here, beneath the waves, as our kind once began in eons past. And it shall be a gathering of the Houses, of everyone of import. If thou hast made allies of others, as thou hast of us, there would be the place to petition thy case to all assembled. And," they add with a bright tone, "I do hope thou wilt enjoy the show."|529|0
units.english: Khiajsore stops in a circular room where the flowers have spread out to colonize the space, dusting the air and water alike with their bright pollen. "I wish to invite thee to our wedding, Captain. Not mine!" they chuckle, "but Myurej's. 'Twill take place here, beneath the waves, as our kind once began in eons past. And it shall be a gathering of the Houses, of everyone of import. If thou hast made allies of others, as thou hast of us, there would be the place to petition thy case to all assembled. And," they add with a bright tone, "I do hope thou wilt enjoy the show."
units.italian: Khiajsore si ferma in una sala circolare dove i fiori si sono allargati a colonizzare lo spazio, impolverando d'aria e d'acqua col loro polline luminoso. "Voglio invitarti al nostro matrimonio, capitano. Non il mio!" ridacchiano, "ma quello di Myurej. Si terrà qui, sotto le onde, come la nostra specie cominciò eoni fa. E sarà un raduno delle Casate, di tutti quelli che contano. Se ti sei fatto alleati di altri, come li hai fatti di noi, quello sarà il luogo per perorare la tua causa davanti a tutti i presenti. E," aggiungono con tono luminoso, "spero proprio che ti godrai lo spettacolo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	They glide over to one of the walls and pluck one of the flowers before returning and offering it to you. The golden bloom rotates to face you as you take it from them, opening wide to reveal its bright interior. "Farewell now." they say, "The complex here shall meet thy needs, if thou requirest rest or aught else before thou must depart. May next we meet be as delightful as today, Captain." Khiajsore splays their arms to you once again, and they are joined by their two escorts as they slither down one of the complex's corridors.|530|0
units.english: They glide over to one of the walls and pluck one of the flowers before returning and offering it to you. The golden bloom rotates to face you as you take it from them, opening wide to reveal its bright interior. "Farewell now." they say, "The complex here shall meet thy needs, if thou requirest rest or aught else before thou must depart. May next we meet be as delightful as today, Captain." Khiajsore splays their arms to you once again, and they are joined by their two escorts as they slither down one of the complex's corridors.
units.italian: Scivolano verso una delle pareti e colgono uno dei fiori, poi tornano e te lo offrono. Il fiore dorato ruota per affrontarti mentre lo prendi, aprendosi ampio a rivelare il suo interno luminoso. "Ora addio," dicono, "il complesso qui soddisferà le tue necessità, se hai bisogno di riposo o di altro prima di dover partire. Che il nostro prossimo incontro sia piacevole come quello di oggi, capitano." Khiajsore apre di nuovo le braccia verso di te, e si uniscono a loro le due scorte mentre scivolano giù per uno dei corridoi del complesso.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Myurej 8|	When, a while later, you take the elevator back up to the planet's surface, you cannot help but notice how similar the window into the dark ocean is to Myurej's shimmering black screen.|531|0
units.english: When, a while later, you take the elevator back up to the planet's surface, you cannot help but notice how similar the window into the dark ocean is to Myurej's shimmering black screen.
units.italian: Quando, un po' più tardi, prendi l'ascensore per risalire in superficie, non puoi fare a meno di notare quanto la finestra sull'oceano scuro somigli allo schermo nero e ondeggiante di Myurej.
